direction: Pokemon-style 2D/2.5D, NOT voxel. Descriptions are the pasted canon manifests, translated to 2D/2.5D sprite notes (geometry words from the paste kept as shape references, not as a 3D engine requirement).

entries.appendages: Long, sharp ears acting as heat-sinks. Tail is a continuous, upward-flowing particle emitter shaped like a flame.
entries.base: Elongated, aerodynamic quadruped chassis optimized for speed.
entries.concept: Sleek, agile wildcat with stripes that crackle with heat.
entries.material_color: Obsidian black #0f0f0f base; stripes are missing geometry acting as windows into blinding magma-orange #ff4400 light.
entries.name: Pyropaw
entries.status: SPEC — described in pasted manifest, not yet a sprite
entries.vfx: Leaves faint scorch marks (black decals) on the floor when it sprints.

entries.appendages: Massive, oversized front paws with curved, black-glass cone claws. Mane is a swirling vortex of aggressive, holographic fire vectors clipping through neck armor.
entries.base: Colossal, heavy-set quadruped with thick, angular armor plating.
entries.concept: Massive, hulking tiger with a roaring fire mane and razor-sharp obsidian claws.
entries.material_color: Dark volcanic rock texture with glowing, intense red-hot fissures.
entries.name: Manticlaw
entries.status: SPEC — described in pasted manifest, not yet a sprite
entries.vfx: Heat-distortion in a 3-unit radius. Screen shakes slightly on roar.

entries.appendages: Floppy, flat stones for ears that clack when it shakes its head. Tiny, wagging pebble tail.
entries.base: Three overlapping, perfectly smooth, round spheres (head, torso, rear).
entries.concept: Playful puppy made of smooth river stones and soft dirt.
entries.material_color: Polished river-stone grey #8899aa with patches of soft, mossy green #557744.
entries.name: Pupbble
entries.status: SPEC — described in pasted manifest, not yet a sprite
entries.vfx: Kicks up tiny, cube-shaped brown dust voxels when it runs toward the player.

entries.appendages: Thick, pillar-like legs. Jaw is a vice-grip made of two jagged slate rocks.
entries.base: Blocky, stout canine frame built like a bulldozer.
entries.concept: Sturdy, armored hound with rocky plating.
entries.material_color: Rough, matte sandstone #c2b280 covered in heavy, dark-grey geometric box armor plates.
entries.name: Terradog
entries.status: SPEC — described in pasted manifest, not yet a sprite
entries.vfx: When it takes damage, it chips off small, temporary rock particles instead of flashing red.

entries.appendages: Massive, spiked paws like piledrivers. Eyes are hollow, glowing amber voids.
entries.base: Towering, imposing wolf silhouette with craggy, mountainous peaks protruding from its spine.
entries.concept: Massive wolf-like beast whose bark literally shakes the terrain.
entries.material_color: Dark bedrock and glowing tectonic-orange #ff3300 veins pulsing with a heartbeat rhythm.
entries.name: Quakehound
entries.status: SPEC — described in pasted manifest, not yet a sprite
entries.vfx: Low-frequency hum. On attack, terrain beneath it depresses and camera shake triggers at maximum intensity.

entries.appendages: Two oversized, cute black dot eyes and two tiny, glowing yellow antenna.
entries.base: Five connected, squishy capsule segments that accordion back and forth to move.
entries.concept: Cute, wriggling digital worm that burrows into the code.
entries.material_color: Bright, neon lime-green #33ff33 with a glossy, plastic-like sheen.
entries.name: Squirmite
entries.status: SPEC — described in pasted manifest, not yet a sprite
entries.vfx: Leaves a faint, temporary trail of glowing binary code (0101) on the ground as it wiggles.

entries.appendages: None. Hops slightly to move, remaining tightly sealed.
entries.base: Rigid, geometric octahedron / diamond-shaped pod standing upright.
entries.concept: Hardened, stationary chrysalis made of metallic silk.
entries.material_color: Highly reflective, brushed silver #cccccc wrapped in crisscrossing, glowing blue fiber-optic cables (silk).
entries.name: Cocoonode
entries.status: SPEC — described in pasted manifest, not yet a sprite
entries.vfx: Slow, pulsing blue light from gaps in its armor, indicating data compiling inside.

entries.appendages: Six delicate, needle-like legs. Two massive, feathery antenna sweeping like radar arrays.
entries.base: Sleek, minimal central body dwarfed by massive, sweeping wing spans.
entries.concept: Beautiful, sweeping moth with wings that look like glowing fiber-optic cables.
entries.material_color: Pure white #ffffff furry body. Wings are transparent glass filled with flowing, neon-rainbow light streaks.
entries.name: Mothrix
entries.status: SPEC — described in pasted manifest, not yet a sprite
entries.vfx: Sheds glowing, multi-colored digital scales (square particles) drifting to the ground, illuminating dark areas.

entries.appendages: Tiny, stubby wings flapping rapidly but unnecessarily, as it naturally hovers 2 units off the ground. Tiny, yellow beak.
entries.base: Perfect, fluffy sphere with virtually no neck.
entries.concept: Tiny, round bird that floats on a constant updraft.
entries.name: Zephling
entries.status: SPEC — described in pasted manifest, not yet a sprite
entries.vfx: Continuous, subtle swirl of white wind-lines (curves) circling beneath it, representing the updraft.

entries.appendages: Wings are rigid, swept-back metal blades. Beak is a literal chrome spike.
entries.base: Sharp, triangular cone silhouette mimicking a stealth bomber.
entries.concept: Sleek raptor designed for high-speed dives.
entries.material_color: Matte carbon-fiber black #1a1a1a with razor-thin, glowing cyan #00ffff aerodynamic lines.
entries.name: Aerobeak
entries.status: SPEC — described in pasted manifest, not yet a sprite
entries.vfx: When diving or attacking, leaves a localized sonic-boom distortion ring in the air.

note: Roster numbering. No geometry invented beyond the pasted descriptions.
